question: What vaccinations do I need?
answer: Yellow fever vaccination is recommended for travel to Kenya. Malaria prophylaxis is also strongly advised, particularly for lower-elevation areas. Vaccinations for routine illnesses (measles, polio, tetanus) are recommended. Consult your healthcare provider at least 4-6 weeks before travel for personalized medical advice. We provide health guidelines when you book, but always consult a travel medicine clinic for professional medical recommendations.
